span.p:
collect NaN/Inf

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
randomized Hadamard rotation
R = (1/sqrt(n))*H*D, seed-driven
spreads outliers -> ~Gaussian

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
budget -> step delta
MSE ~= delta^2 * G_lattice
verify-loop tightens to meet budget

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
scalar quantizer
round each coord (Z lattice)

span.p:
E8 lattice quantizer
nearest of D8 and D8+1/2
8-D blocks + 1 coset bit/block
